title: OAT Observation Data Standard (oat-ods) v0.3
description: One measurement per message. Logical stream is the primary key; physical source is swappable provenance. Three envelopes share this schema: a standalone observation, a node status/heartbeat, and a batch carrying many observations in one signed body. Consumers MUST ignore unknown fields (forward-compatibility).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this JSON Schema (self-description).

msg_type.description: observation (default) = one measurement. status = node liveness/health. batch = an envelope whose messages[] carries many observations in one body.

state.description: Availability on a status message (Sparkplug-flavored liveness).

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the value was measured or the aggregate closed.

stream.description: Logical identity — the primary key. Survives hardware swaps.

id.description: Stable logical slot id (location/role). Defaults to the MAC if unassigned.

measurement.description: Quantity kind from the oat-measurands.yaml dictionary (§5). Open string (consumers MUST ignore unknown); a key the dictionary hasn't mapped is forwarded raw.

unit.description: SenML unit symbol. Canonical units only on the wire (Cel, %RH, %, dBm, ppm, Pa, lx).

agg.description: Optional aggregation metadata. Absent => instantaneous reading.

source.description: Physical provenance — swappable. At least one of gateway_id / physical_id is required.

gateway_id.description: Assignable node identity (NOT the raw MAC).

farm_id.description: The OPERATOR this node belongs to. One grower with ten nodes is one farm_id and ten gateway_ids — the grouping an endpoint needs to answer 'whose data is this?' without inferring it from node names.

device_id.description: Status message only: the node hardware id (efuse-MAC, e.g. oat-3c8a1fa77d14). Informative provenance — the node-level twin of physical_id; identity still keys on gateway_id.

physical_id.description: The hardware now filling the slot (MAC/serial).

health.description: Node self-report, carried on a status/heartbeat message (see contract 7.2).

reset.description: Last reset reason (poweron|usb|panic|task_wdt|brownout|...); usb = post-flash reset on native-USB chips.

temp_c.description: Internal die temperature C (uncalibrated on classic ESP32).

lan_ip.description: Station IP on the site LAN — how to reach the node's setup page.

ble_seen.description: BLE adverts heard since boot (BLE-tier nodes).

ble_matched.description: BLE adverts matched to a reportable sensor since boot.

sent_at.description: Batch envelope: when the body was sent. Each message keeps its own observed_at, which is the instant that matters for the series.

seq.description: Batch envelope: monotonic per-body sequence from the node, for replay detection. Resets are visible via the status message's boot_count.

messages.description: Batch envelope: the observations. Required when msg_type is batch.

message.description: One observation inside a batch. Identical to a standalone observation except that the envelope keys (schema, msg_type, sent_at, seq) live on the envelope, and source may be partial because the envelope's source supplies the node-level fields.
